scenario: CallIssued stream event per LFST.6.3 — when a rule fires a call action, an action_call event is emitted to the stream carrying the service target and correlation. Integrator callback receives the call; engine stays thin-verb (IDSP.6).
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

service light.turn_on:
    "stub service for conformance"
    no response

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call light.turn_on nocooldown as "c1"
